decisions.decision: Kept front segment filename prefix seg_*.ts (plan called for front_*.ts)
decisions.rationale: 40+ references in existing tests and code; rename was churn with no functional win. Only cabin pattern cabin_*.ts was added.

decisions.decision: Cabin segments share the front segment's PTS clock via single-ffmpeg dual-output
decisions.rationale: Eliminates the whole class of PiP sync bugs from the MJPG-era separate-process architecture.

decisions.decision: setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+intro/TB (not just PTS+intro/TB) on cabin overlay input
decisions.rationale: After -segment_wrap cycling, cabin segments have non-zero start PTS. Preserving that offset made PiP render invisible on first Pi deploy.
H264 passthrough segment boundaries are NOT keyframe-aligned (camera controls GOP). Decoding from packet 0 produces mid-GOP garbage. Skipping non-keyframes forces decoder to wait for an I-frame.
